data.name: RG_ICE_01
data.value: This chamber is colder than the corridor.[pause=25] Far colder.[pause=20] Frost is climbing the walls,[pause=10] and climbing fast.

data.name: RG_ICE_02
data.value: The frost isn't falling from the ceiling...[pause=25] it's RISING.[pause=20] It's coming from something,[pause=15] at the back.

data.name: RG_ICE_03
data.value: (Every step cracks a film of ice that wasn't there at the entrance.)

data.name: RG_ICE_04
data.value: YOU GATHERED THE SIGNS.[pause=25] NO ONE HAS DONE THAT SINCE...[pause=30] I NO LONGER KNOW.[pause=20] THE COUNT WAS LOST WITH THE REST.

data.name: RG_ICE_05
data.value: He doesn't know how long he's been here...[pause=25] How do you forget a thing like that?

data.name: RG_ICE_06
data.value: COLD PRESERVES EVERYTHING.[pause=25] STONE,[pause=15] BODIES,[pause=15] ORDERS.[pause=30] EVERYTHING,[pause=20] EXCEPT THE REASON THEY WERE GIVEN.

data.name: RG_ICE_07
data.value: I KEPT THE ORDER INTACT.[pause=25] IT IS THE WHY THAT MELTED.[pause=30] SHOW ME YOU ARE WORTH WHAT I FORGOT.

data.name: RG_ICE_08
data.value: We can't give him his memory back.[pause=25] But we can give him an answer.[pause=20] Ready?

data.name: RG_ICE_09
data.value: ...YOU WERE WARMER THAN THE ORDER.[pause=30] THAT IS ALREADY AN ANSWER.[pause=25] GO SEE THE OTHER TWO.[pause=20] THEY REMEMBER BETTER THAN I DO.

data.name: RG_ICE_10
data.value: He's sending us to the others...[pause=25] As if he knew we'd come back with questions.

data.name: RG_ICE_11
data.value: THE COLD TOOK YOU BACK.[pause=25] IT TAKES EVERYTHING BACK,[pause=15] IN THE END.[pause=30] RETURN WHEN YOU BURN BRIGHTER.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE
data.value: The guardian goes still.[pause=25] No crack,[pause=15] no collapse:[pause=20] it simply stands straighter than before,[pause=15] as if relieved of a weight.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE_P
data.value: Where it kept watch,[pause=20] the stone has split.[pause=25] Steps descend into the dark.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE
data.value: The floor gives way.[pause=25] The guardian doesn't pursue:[pause=15] it simply returns to its post,[pause=10] and waits.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE_P
data.value: We got thrown out...[pause=20] but it didn't finish us.[pause=25] It's waiting for us to come back ready.[pause=20] So let's go back.
